solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/backspace-string-compare/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

844. Backspace String Compare

Given two strings s and t, return true if they are equal when both are typed into empty text editors. '#' means a backspace character.

Note that after backspacing an empty text, the text will continue empty.

Example 1:

Input: s = "ab#c", t = "ad#c"
Output: true
Explanation: Both s and t become "ac".

Example 2:

Input: s = "ab##", t = "c#d#"
Output: true
Explanation: Both s and t become "".

Example 3:

Input: s = "a#c", t = "b"
Output: false
Explanation: s becomes "c" while t becomes "b".

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length, t.length <= 200
    s and t only contain lowercase letters and '#' characters.

Follow up: Can you solve it in O(n) time and O(1) space?
"""


class Solution:
    def backspaceCompare(self, s: str, t: str) -> bool:
        def build(string: str) -> str:
            result = []
            for ch in string:
                if ch == "#":
                    if result:
                        result.pop()
                else:
                    result.append(ch)
            return "".join(result)

        return build(s) == build(t)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.backspaceCompare("ab#c", "ad#c"))  # True

assert sol.backspaceCompare("ab#c", "ad#c") is True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("ab##", "c#d#") is True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a#c", "b") is False

assert sol.backspaceCompare("", "") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("#", "#") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a", "a") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a#", "") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("abc###", "") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("abc#d", "abd") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a##b", "b") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a#b#c#d#", "") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a#b#c#d#e", "e") == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a" * 200, "a" * 200) == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a" * 199 + "#", "a" * 198) == True
assert sol.backspaceCompare("a#b#c#d#e#f#g#h#i#j#", "") == True
